tree: We’re a group of four and would love to book a spa afternoon this Saturday, ideally around 2:00 PM. Do you have availability, and is there a group rate?
Hi Sarah, thanks for reaching out! We can fit your group of four this Saturday at 2:00 PM. I’ll send the booking link and group rate details now.
How can a team manage customer emails from one inbox?
Shared email inbox software puts customer emails in one team inbox, with an owner on each thread and notes the customer never sees, so replies are faster and nothing is answered twice.
Customer emails sit in personal inboxes, and some get answered twice or not at all.
Every email has an owner, a status and the full customer history beside it.
Shared email inbox software keeps the team in sync.
